title: Identity and Role Propagation
excerpt: Identity and Role Propagation When building production MCP servers, you often need to know who is calling a tool so you can enforce permissions, filter data, or audit access. The MCP C SDK provides built in support for propagating the caller's identity from the transport layer into your tool, prompt, and resource handlers — no custom headers or workarounds required.
